test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Successive discounts of 18% and 22% are equal to a single discount of ______.
solution:
**Given**:

Successive discounts of 18% and 22% 

**Concept used: **

Single Discount = D1 + D2 - (D1D2)/100

D1 & D2 are two successive discounts.

**Calculation:**

Single Discount = 18 + 22 - dfrac{18×22}{100}

⇒ 40 - 3.96

⇒ 36.04%

**∴ Successive discounts of 18% and 22% are equal to a single discount of 36.04%.**
